description:
Get the live direct-booking price of a WEE WiLDS unit for given dates.

    With check_in and check_out: total_gbp for the stay (per room for "bb"),
    today's price from the booking system, confirmed when the guest books at the
    booking page. A stay that cannot be booked comes back with available=false
    and a reason instead of a price. Without dates: a min/max nightly range.

    Args:
        unit: One of "muckle-meadow-pod", "cosie-coorie-pod", "bb".
        check_in: Arrival date YYYY-MM-DD (optional; needed for a live total).
        check_out: Departure date YYYY-MM-DD (optional; needed for a live total).

check_in.description: Arrival date, YYYY-MM-DD. Give both dates for the live total; without them you get the nightly range.
check_in.title: Check In

unit.description: Which WEE WiLDS unit: "muckle-meadow-pod" (Muckle Meadow Glamping Pod), "cosie-coorie-pod" (Cosy Coorie Pod) or "bb" (the B&B, all 4 rooms).
unit.title: Unit

name: get_pricing

RoomPrice.description: One B&B room. Fields mean the same as the top-level stay and price fields.

outputSchema.description: live_quote: per-stay totals (per room for "bb"). static_range: nightly range only.

available.description: true: bookable as asked. false: not bookable, see reason. null: could not be confirmed just now, send the guest to the booking page.

book_url.description: Booking page with these dates already selected and the live total shown; give it to the guest to reserve and pay. Absent when the stay cannot be booked.

error.description: Present only when the request could not be answered; says why.

min_nights_from_arrival.description: Minimum stay for this arrival date today. Minimums relax as the date gets closer.

nights_booked.description: Nights in the stay that are already booked, YYYY-MM-DD.

note.description: How to present the price to the guest.

opens_on.description: YYYY-MM-DD the dates open for booking (verdict not_open_yet).

pricing_model.description: "live_quote" (dates given, total for those dates) or "static_range" (nightly min/max, no dates or live price unavailable).

quoted_at.description: When the live price was fetched, ISO 8601 UTC.

reason.description: Plain-English reason, ready to tell the guest.

shortest_bookable_nights.description: Shortest stay that can be booked from this arrival date; suggest it when the asked stay is too short.

total_gbp.description: Live direct-booking total for the whole stay in GBP, as of quoted_at. Absent when the stay is not bookable; null when no live price could be fetched.

url.description: Unit page with the live booking calendar.

valid_units.description: Valid unit slugs, on an unknown unit.

verdict.description: Machine-readable reason: bookable, booked, blocked, not_open_yet, departs_after_window, too_soon, in_the_past, min_stay, max_stay, arrival_not_allowed, departure_not_allowed, rules_unavailable, no_rules or unknown.

title: Get price
